about: Country cards for lives born in Germany. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Germany (DE) ===================== Ausbildung: the average collectively agreed training allowance was €1,133 a month in 2024 (BIBB press release, 6 Feb 2025): €13,600 a year ÷ 0.688 (PPP) ≈ 0.62 of the game's typical wage, paid while training (as a study with pay). Public universities charge no tuition. The skill gained is a game rule. Choosing it counts as a diploma, so the card at 18 is skipped.

opts.do: done.edu = 'dip'; const lab = M('lbl.ausb'); study = { end: age + 3, gain: 5 * learnLuck('ausb'), pt: .62, label: lab, k: 'dip' }; T('sk_edu', { kind: 'skill', label: lab })

en..x: Instead of the Abitur and university, you could start an Ausbildung: three years of training split between a company and a vocational school, paid an average of €1,133 a month in 2024. Public universities charge no tuition fees.
en..ausb.s: Earn about {a} a year while you train, and finish with a vocational qualification.
en..ausb.h: Skill +5 a year for 3 years; it counts as a diploma.
en..abi.s: Then choose between university, a diploma and work.

zh..x: 除了读文理中学毕业考（Abitur）再上大学，你也可以开始职业培训（Ausbildung）：三年时间在公司和职业学校之间学习，2024年平均每月津贴1,133欧元。公立大学不收学费。
zh..ausb.s: 培训期间每年赚约{a}，结业时拿到职业资格。
zh..abi.s: 之后再选上大学、读文凭或工作。

zht..x: 除了讀文理中學畢業考（Abitur）再上大學，你也可以開始職業培訓（Ausbildung）：三年時間在公司和職業學校之間學習，2024年平均每月津貼1,133歐元。公立大學不收學費。
zht..ausb.s: 培訓期間每年賺約{a}，結業時拿到職業資格。
zht..abi.s: 之後再選上大學、讀文憑或工作。

events.src: BAföG: up to €992 a month from winter 2025/26 for students living away from home, by parents' income; half grant, half interest-free loan, repayment capped at €10,010 and starting five years after the funding ends, usually €130 a month (Studierendenwerke FAQ, Jan 2026). In game money: €992 × 12 ÷ 0.688 ≈ 0.54; the cap ≈ 0.45; €130 a month ≈ 0.07.

let.g: byFam({ poor: .54, working: .38, middle: .15, rich: 0 }) * base

opts.do: T('de_bafog', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_bafog') }); rec('de_bafog', -g, y); later(study.end + 5, 'bafog', { a: Math.min(.5 * g * y, .45 * base) })
T('de_ws', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_ws') }); rec('de_ws', -.3 * base, y); happy -= 2; addSkill('ws', 2, M('trk.de_ws'))

later.bafog: const y = Math.ceil(x.a / (.07 * base)); rec('de_bafog', .07 * base, y)

en..x: BAföG, the state study grant, pays up to €992 a month (from winter 2025/26) if you live away from home, depending on your parents’ income. Half is a grant and half an interest-free loan, and nobody repays more than €10,010.
en..apply.s: About {a} a year while you study. You repay half, interest-free, starting five years after your studies.
en..no: Your parents earn too much for BAföG.
en..work.s: About {a} a year for 20 hours a week. Less free time: Happiness −2.
en..parents.s: They cover your rent and food.

zh..x: 国家助学金BAföG视父母收入而定，不住家里的学生每月最多992欧元（2025/26冬季学期起）。一半是补助、一半是免息贷款，最多只需还10,010欧元。
zh..apply.s: 读书期间每年约{a}。其中一半免息，毕业五年后开始还。
zh..no: 你父母的收入太高，领不到BAföG。
zh..work.s: 每周20小时，每年约{a}。空闲时间少了：幸福感 −2。
zh..parents.s: 他们负担你的房租和伙食。

zht..x: 國家助學金BAföG視父母收入而定，不住家裡的學生每月最多992歐元（2025/26冬季學期起）。一半是補助、一半是免息貸款，最多只需還10,010歐元。
zht..apply.s: 讀書期間每年約{a}。其中一半免息，畢業五年後開始還。
zht..no: 你父母的收入太高，領不到BAföG。
zht..work.s: 每週20小時，每年約{a}。空閒時間少了：幸福感 −2。
zht..parents.s: 他們負擔你的房租和伙食。

events.src: Renting for life: 47.6% of Germans owned their home in 2023, the EU's lowest (Eurostat, via Bundestag research service WD 7-065/24); land transfer tax is 3.5–6.5% by state (finanz.de, 2026), plus notary, land registry and often an agent: about 11% in all.

opts.ok: liq >= .31 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.31 * P), h: MN(liq) })

opts.do: yearly('etf', { amt: a, until: age + 30 }, {}, 'trk.etf')

en..x: About half of Germans rent for life (47.6% owned their home in 2023, the lowest share in the EU), and tenants are well protected. Buying adds about 10–12% on top of the price: land transfer tax of 3.5–6.5%, notary and land registry fees, and often an agent. A family home costs {p}.
en..buy.s: {d} up front (fees included), then {m} a year.
en..etf.s: An ETF savings plan of about {a} a year for 30 years.

zh..x: 大约一半的德国人一辈子租房（2023年住房自有率47.6%，欧盟最低），租客受到很好的保护。买房要在房价外多付约10–12%：3.5–6.5%的房地产转让税、公证和土地登记费，常常还有中介费。一间家庭住房要{p}。
zh..buy.s: 首付{d}（含各项费用），之后每年{m}。

zht..x: 大約一半的德國人一輩子租房（2023年住房自有率47.6%，歐盟最低），租客受到很好的保護。買房要在房價外多付約10–12%：3.5–6.5%的房地產轉讓稅、公證和土地登記費，常常還有中介費。一間家庭住房要{p}。
zht..buy.s: 頭期款{d}（含各項費用），之後每年{m}。
zht..etf.s: ETF定期定額計畫，每年約{a}，投30年。

events.src: Riester: put in 4% of last year's pay to get the full state allowance of €175 a year plus €300 per child born from 2008 (§§ 84–86 EStG). €175 ≈ 0.008 and €300 ≈ 0.014 of the game's typical wage. Fees (about 1.2% a year) are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: yearly('riester', { p: .04, until: 66, bonus: bon }, { lock: 62, fee: .012 }, 'trk.riester')
yearly('etf2', { p: .04, until: 66 }, {}, 'trk.etf')

en..x: With a Riester pension, put in 4% of last year’s pay and the state adds €175 a year, plus €300 for each child born since 2008. Riester contracts often charge high fees.
en..riester.s: {a} a year; the state adds {b}. Locked until 62.
en..etf.s: {a} a year, no allowance, no lock.

zh..x: 里斯特养老金：存入上一年收入的4%，国家每年补贴175欧元，2008年以后出生的每个孩子再补300欧元。里斯特合约的手续费常常很高。
zh..etf.s: 每年{a}，没有补贴，也不锁定。

zht..x: 里斯特退休金：存入上一年收入的4%，國家每年補貼175歐元，2008年以後出生的每個孩子再補300歐元。里斯特合約的手續費常常很高。
zht..etf.s: 每年{a}，沒有補貼，也不鎖定。

events.src: Elterngeld: about 65% of net pay (67% below €1,200), €300–1,800 a month, for up to 12 months per parent, 14 if both take part; Elternzeit (unpaid leave) up to three years (BEEG, via HUK and kita.de).

opts.do: tmpPay('de_eltern', .65, 1, 'trk.de_eltern'); happy += 3
tmpPay('de_eltern', .94, 1, 'trk.de_eltern'); happy += 1
const t = T('de_eltern', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_eltern3') }); rec('de_eltern', -.6 * Math.max(0, salary()), 1); offUntil = age + 3; ppM = (ppM || 1) * .85; happy += 4

en..x: After a birth, each parent can take up to three years of Elternzeit. Elterngeld replaces about 65% of take-home pay, up to €1,800 a month, for up to 12 months (14 if both parents take part).
en..year.s: About 65% of your pay for a year. Happiness +3.
en..two: Two months, then back to work
en..two.s: A small dip in pay this year. Happiness +1.
en..three.s: Elterngeld in the first year, then no pay for two. Happiness +4.

zh..x: 孩子出生后，父母每人最多可请三年育儿假（Elternzeit）。父母津贴（Elterngeld）约为税后收入的65%，每月最多1,800欧元，最多12个月（父母都请假可达14个月）。
zh..year.s: 一年领约65%的工资。幸福感 +3。
zh..two: 请两个月，然后回去上班
zh..two.s: 今年收入稍微少一点。幸福感 +1。
zh..three.s: 第一年有父母津贴，之后两年没有收入。幸福感 +4。

zht..x: 孩子出生後，父母每人最多可請三年育兒假（Elternzeit）。父母津貼（Elterngeld）約為稅後收入的65%，每月最多1,800歐元，最多12個月（父母都請假可達14個月）。
zht..year.s: 一年領約65%的薪水。幸福感 +3。
zht..two: 請兩個月，然後回去上班
zht..two.s: 今年收入稍微少一點。幸福感 +1。
zht..three.s: 第一年有父母津貼，之後兩年沒有收入。幸福感 +4。

events.src: Tax returns: of 14.9 million employees assessed for 2021, 86% got a refund, averaging €1,172 (Destatis, via VLH): ≈ 0.053. An average of about 0.045 a year after costs is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('de_tax', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_tax') }); rec('de_tax', -.045 * B, 25)
T('de_tax', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_tax') }); rec('de_tax', -.035 * B, 25)

en..x: Filing a tax return is optional for most employees, but 86% of those who filed for 2021 got money back, on average €1,172.
en..diy.s: Tax software and an evening each spring: back about {a} a year.
en..help.s: They do it for a yearly fee: back about {a} a year after the fee.

zh..x: 大多数员工可以不报税，但2021年报税的人有86%拿到退税，平均1,172欧元。
zh..diy.s: 报税软件，每年春天花一个晚上：每年退约{a}。
zh..help.s: 他们收年费帮你报：扣掉年费每年退约{a}。

zht..x: 大多數員工可以不報稅，但2021年報稅的人有86%拿到退稅，平均1,172歐元。
zht..diy.s: 報稅軟體，每年春天花一個晚上：每年退約{a}。
zht..help.s: 他們收年費幫你報：扣掉年費每年退約{a}。

events.src: Minijob: earnings up to €556 a month in 2025, free of income tax and of the worker's social contributions (§ 8 SGB IV; the limit follows the minimum wage): €6,672 a year ≈ 0.3; about 0.25 after travel and time, an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('de_mini', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_mini') }); rec('de_mini', -.25 * base, 5, -.5); happy -= 2

en..x: A Minijob on the side: you can earn up to €556 a month (2025) with no income tax or social contributions taken off.
en..yes.s: About {a} a year for evenings and weekends. Happiness −2.
en..yes.h: Health −0.5 a year for five years.

zh..x: 兼一份迷你工作（Minijob）：每月最多可赚556欧元（2025年），不扣所得税和社保。
zh..yes.s: 晚上和周末上班，每年约{a}。幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 兼一份迷你工作（Minijob）：每月最多可賺556歐元（2025年），不扣所得稅和社會保險。
zht..yes.s: 晚上和週末上班，每年約{a}。幸福感 −2。

events.src: Retiring: after 45 insured years, from 65 with no deduction (born 1964 or later, § 38 SGB VI); with 35 years up to four years before 67 with 0.3% less per month (14.4% at 63); each month after 67 adds 0.5% (§ 77 SGB VI) (Deutsche Rentenversicherung rules, as summarised by gegen-hartz.de).

opts.do: penClaim(q[0], q[1], 'de_rente')

en..x: With 35 insured years you can claim your pension up to four years before the regular age of 67, losing 0.3% for every month early (14.4% at 63). After 45 years you can go at 65 with no deduction. Each month you work past 67 adds 0.5%.
en..63.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..65.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..67.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..70.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.

zh..x: 缴满35年保险，可以在法定的67岁前最多提早四年领养老金，每提前一个月少0.3%（63岁领少14.4%）。缴满45年，65岁就能领且不打折。67岁以后每多工作一个月，增加0.5%。
zh..63.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..65.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..67.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..70.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。

zht..x: 繳滿35年保險，可以在法定的67歲前最多提早四年領退休金，每提前一個月少0.3%（63歲領少14.4%）。繳滿45年，65歲就能領且不打折。67歲以後每多工作一個月，增加0.5%。
zht..63.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..65.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..67.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..70.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。

events.src: Saving in Germany: households hold more than €3 trillion in cash and bank deposits (Deutsche Bundesbank, financial accounts, 2025). A Bausparvertrag pays very little interest while you save and then entitles you to a fixed-rate home loan; the Wohnungsbauprämie adds 10% for lower incomes (BMF). Returns after inflation (a world ETF about 5% on average, a Bausparvertrag about −1.5%) are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: yearly('de_etf', { amt: .06 * base, until: age + 30 }, {}, 'trk.de_etf')
yearly('de_bspar', { amt: .06 * base, until: age + 7, bonus: .03 }, { rate: -.015 }, 'trk.de_bspar')

en..x: Your bank adviser suggests a Bausparvertrag, like the one your parents had. A colleague swears by an ETF savings plan: a fixed amount into a world index fund every month.
en..etf.s: About {a} a year into a world index fund.
en..etf.h: About 5% a year after inflation on average, with crashes along the way.
en..bspar.s: About {a} a year for seven years, for the right to a fixed-rate home loan later.
en..bspar.h: It earns almost nothing, so inflation shrinks it; the state adds a small bonus.
en..konto: Keep it in your current account

zh..x: 银行理财顾问建议你签一份住房储蓄合约（Bausparvertrag），就像你父母当年那样。一位同事则大力推荐ETF定投：每个月固定买一点全球指数基金。
zh..etf.s: 每年大约{a}买全球指数基金。
zh..etf.h: 扣除通胀后平均每年约5%，中间会碰上股灾。
zh..bspar.s: 七年内每年大约{a}，换取将来申请固定利率房贷的资格。
zh..bspar.h: 几乎没有利息，会被通胀慢慢吃掉；政府会补贴一点。

zht..x: 銀行理專建議你簽一份住房儲蓄合約（Bausparvertrag），就像你父母當年那樣。一位同事則大力推薦ETF定期定額：每個月固定買一點全球指數基金。
zht..etf.s: 每年大約{a}買全球指數基金。
zht..etf.h: 扣除通膨後平均每年約5%，中間會碰上股災。
zht..bspar.s: 七年內每年大約{a}，換取將來申請固定利率房貸的資格。
zht..bspar.h: 幾乎沒有利息，會被通膨慢慢吃掉；政府會補貼一點。

events.src: Private health insurance: employees earning more than €77,400 a year (2026; €73,800 in 2025) may leave the statutory scheme (GKV) for private insurance (PKV) (Rechengrößen 2026, via krankenkassen.de). GKV contributions are a share of pay up to €69,750 a year (2026); PKV premiums depend on your age and health when you join and rise with age, and returning to the GKV after 55 is almost impossible (§ 6 (3a) SGB V). The saving while young and the share of bills paid are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: medPlan('de_pkv', .6, 0); T('de_pkvs', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_pkvs') }); rec('de_pkvs', -.1 * base, Math.max(1, 56 - age)); happy += 1; next('de_pkv2', Math.max(1, 56 - age), {})

en..x: Your pay is now above the line where you may leave the statutory health insurance. A broker shows you a private plan: lower premiums than your GKV contributions while you are young, and faster appointments.
en..pkv.s: Lower premiums now; they depend on your age and health when you join.
en..pkv.h: Saves about a tenth of a typical wage a year for now and pays more of your bills; premiums rise steeply with age.
en..gkv.s: Contributions follow your pay; your family is covered free.

zh..x: 你的收入已经超过可以退出法定医保的门槛。保险经纪人给你看一份私人医保：年轻时保费比法定医保的缴费低，看诊也更快。
zh..pkv.s: 现在保费较低；保费看你投保时的年龄和健康状况。
zh..pkv.h: 目前每年省下大约十分之一个一般工资，理赔也比较多；但保费会随年龄大涨。
zh..gkv.s: 缴费按收入计算；家人可以免费附保。

zht..x: 你的收入已經超過可以退出法定健保的門檻。保險經紀人給你看一份私人健康保險：年輕時保費比法定健保的繳費低，看診也更快。
zht..pkv.s: 現在保費較低；保費看你投保時的年齡和健康狀況。
zht..pkv.h: 目前每年省下大約十分之一個一般薪資，理賠也比較多；但保費會隨年齡大漲。
zht..gkv.s: 繳費按收入計算；家人可以免費依附投保。

events.src: Private health insurance premiums rise with age and medical costs; insurers must offer a cheaper Standardtarif with cover like the GKV’s, and going back to the GKV after 55 is almost impossible (§ 6 (3a) SGB V; PKV-Verband). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('de_pkv2', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.de_pkv2') }); rec('de_pkv2', .2 * base, 30)
T('de_pkvstd', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.de_pkvstd') }); rec('de_pkvstd', .1 * base, 30); medCut = .85
T('de_pkvded', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.de_pkvded') }); rec('de_pkvded', .13 * base, 30); medCut = .75

en..x: Your private health insurer has raised your premium again: now in your late fifties, you pay several times what you paid when you joined. Going back to the statutory scheme is no longer possible.
en..pay.s: About {a} a year from now on.
en..std.s: About {a} a year, with cover like the statutory scheme.
en..std.h: It pays a smaller share of your bills.
en..deduct.s: About {a} a year; you pay the first part of each year’s bills.
en..deduct.h: It pays less of the smaller bills.
en.trk.de_pkvded: A plan with a higher deductible

zh..x: 私人医保公司又涨保费了：你快六十岁了，现在的保费是当初投保时的好几倍。想回法定医保也已经回不去了。
zh..std.s: 每年大约{a}，保障和法定医保差不多。
zh..deduct.s: 每年大约{a}；每年开头一部分医疗费用要自己付。
zh..deduct.h: 小额的医疗费理赔变少。

zht..x: 私人健康保險公司又漲保費了：你快六十歲了，現在的保費是當初投保時的好幾倍。想回法定健保也已經回不去了。
zht..std.s: 每年大約{a}，保障和法定健保差不多。
zht..deduct.s: 每年大約{a}；每年開頭一部分醫療費用要自己付。
zht..deduct.h: 小額的醫療費理賠變少。

events.src: Church tax: members of the Catholic and Protestant churches pay 8% (Bavaria, Baden-Württemberg) or 9% (other states) of their income tax as church tax, collected with it (church tax laws of the states). In 2025, 307,117 people left the Catholic Church and about 350,000 the Protestant churches (German Bishops’ Conference; EKD, via ZDF). The saving (about 1.2% of pay) and the effect on family ties are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: T('de_kist', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_kist') }); rec('de_kist', -.012 * salary(), 40)

en..x: Your payslip shows church tax: 9% on top of your income tax. Hundreds of thousands of Germans leave the church every year; your grandmother would be upset if you did.
en..leave.s: A short visit to the registry office, and the church tax stops.
en..leave.h: Saves about 1% of your pay a year; Relationships −1.

zh..x: 你的工资单上有一项教会税：所得税之外再加9%。每年有几十万德国人退出教会；可要是你也退出，祖母会很难过。
zh..leave.s: 去户政局办个手续，教会税就停了。
zh..leave.h: 每年省下大约1%的薪水；人际关系 −1。

zht..x: 你的薪資單上有一項教會稅：所得稅之外再加9%。每年有幾十萬德國人退出教會；可是要是你也退出，祖母會很難過。
zht..leave.s: 去戶政機關辦個手續，教會稅就停了。
zht..leave.h: 每年省下大約1%的薪水；人際關係 −1。

events.src: Personal liability insurance (Privathaftpflicht): not compulsory, but about 83% of households have it (GDV, from the 2018 household budget survey); you are liable for damage you cause others, with no upper limit (§ 823 BGB). A policy costs from about €50 a year (≈ 0.003). The size of a claim and its odds are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: de_haft = 1; T('de_haft', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.de_haft') }); rec('de_haft', .003 * base, 40)

en..x: Now that you have moved out, your parents ask whether you have Haftpflicht: if you damage someone else’s property or hurt someone, you pay for it, with no upper limit.
en..no.h: If you ever cause serious damage, you pay all of it.

zh..x: 你搬出去住了，父母问你有没有保个人责任险：要是你弄坏别人的东西或害别人受伤，你得负责赔偿，而且没有上限。
zh..no.h: 要是哪天闯了大祸，全部都得自己赔。

zht..x: 你搬出去住了，父母問你有沒有保個人責任險：要是你弄壞別人的東西或害別人受傷，你得負責賠償，而且沒有上限。
zht..no.h: 要是哪天闖了大禍，全部都得自己賠。

events.src: Liability claims: a burst washing-machine hose or a cycling accident can cost thousands of euros, which a liability policy pays (GDV). Amounts and odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: if (de_haft) happy -= 1; else { spend('de_dmg', .4 * base, 'trk.de_dmg'); happy -= 3 }
rl(-2); if (roll('de_haft2') < .7) spend('de_dmg', (de_haft ? .1 : .5) * base, 'trk.de_dmg')

en..x: Your washing machine hose burst while you were at work, and the water has come through the ceiling of the flat below. Their kitchen needs replacing.
en..deal.s: With liability insurance, the insurer pays; without it, about {a}.
en..deny.s: Their insurer may take you to court.
en..deny.h: It usually costs more in the end; Relationships −2.

zh..x: 你上班的时候洗衣机水管爆了，水渗过天花板流进楼下住户家里。他们的厨房得整个换掉。
zh..deal.s: 有责任险就由保险公司赔；没有的话大约{a}。
zh..deny.s: 对方的保险公司可能会告你。
zh..deny.h: 到头来通常花得更多；人际关系 −2。

zht..x: 你上班的時候洗衣機水管爆了，水滲過天花板流進樓下住戶家裡。他們的廚房得整個換掉。
zht..deal.s: 有責任險就由保險公司賠；沒有的話大約{a}。
zht..deny.s: 對方的保險公司可能會告你。
zht..deny.h: 到頭來通常花得更多；人際關係 −2。

events.src: Part-time work: in 2024, 68% of working mothers with children under 18 worked part-time, against 8% of fathers (Destatis, Mikrozensus 2024). Since 2019, staff at firms with more than 45 employees can work part-time for one to five years and then return to full-time (Brückenteilzeit, § 9a TzBfG). The effects on pay, promotion and pension are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: tmpPay('de_tz', .55, 6, 'trk.de_tz'); bump('de_tzc', .95, M('trk.de_tzc')); happy += 3; rl(3)
tmpPay('de_btz', .7, 3, 'trk.de_btz'); happy += 2; rl(2)
happy -= 1

en..x: Your child has a Kita place now, until two in the afternoon. Most parents you know, nearly all of them mothers, have gone part-time; HR says you could too.
en..part: Go part-time for a few years
en..part.s: Around 20 hours a week, with pay to match.
en..part.h: Pay about 45% lower for six years, and a little lower for good after; Happiness +3, Relationships +3.
en..bridge: Bridge part-time, then back to full-time
en..bridge.s: Fewer hours for three years, with the right to return.
en..bridge.h: Pay 30% lower for three years; Happiness +2, Relationships +2.
en..full.s: Pick-ups and errands get squeezed in.
en.trk.de_tz: Part-time while the children are small

zh..x: 孩子现在上了托儿所，只到下午两点。你认识的家长大多改成兼职了，几乎都是妈妈；人事部说你也可以。
zh..part.s: 每周大约20小时，薪水也按比例。
zh..part.h: 六年内收入少约45%，之后也一直低一点；幸福感 +3，人际关系 +3。
zh..bridge.s: 三年内减少工时，之后有权回到全职。
zh..bridge.h: 三年内收入少30%；幸福感 +2，人际关系 +2。
zh..full.s: 接送和杂事只能硬挤时间。

zht..x: 孩子現在上了托兒所，只到下午兩點。你認識的家長大多改成部分工時了，幾乎都是媽媽；人資部說你也可以。
zht..part.s: 每週大約20小時，薪水也按比例。
zht..part.h: 六年內收入少約45%，之後也一直低一點；幸福感 +3，人際關係 +3。
zht..bridge: 過渡部分工時，之後回全職
zht..bridge.s: 三年內減少工時，之後有權回到全職。
zht..bridge.h: 三年內收入少30%；幸福感 +2，人際關係 +2。
zht..full.s: 接送和雜事只能硬擠時間。
zht.trk.de_tzc: 部分工時幾年後的職涯

events.src: Heating: the Building Energy Act (GEG) requires new heating systems to run on 65% renewable energy, phased in with each town’s heat plan (2026 for big cities, 2028 for the rest) (BMWK). KfW pays a 30% base grant for a heat pump, up to 70% with bonuses, on costs up to €28,000 for the first home (KfW programme 458 from July 2026, via test.de). The CO2 price on heating fuel is €55–65 a tonne in 2026 and is due to move to the EU’s ETS2 market (BEHG; EU). Costs (a heat pump about €30,000 before the grant, a gas boiler about €10,000) and running costs are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: spend('de_hp', .75 * base, 'trk.de_hp'); T('de_hps', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_hps') }); rec('de_hps', -.03 * base, 20)
spend('de_gas', .45 * base, 'trk.de_gas')
spend('de_fix', .05 * base, 'trk.de_fix')

en..x: Your gas boiler is 25 years old, and the heating engineer won’t promise it will last another winter. A heat pump would get a KfW grant; a new gas boiler costs less now, but the CO2 price on gas keeps rising.
en..hp.h: Lower heating bills for twenty years, and no CO2 price.
en..gas.h: Cheaper now; gas bills rise as the CO2 price goes up.

zh..x: 你家的燃气锅炉已经用了25年，暖气师傅不敢保证它还能撑过一个冬天。装热泵可以拿到复兴信贷银行（KfW）的补助；新的燃气锅炉现在比较便宜，但燃气的碳价一直在涨。
zh..hp.h: 之后二十年暖气费比较低，也不用付碳价。
zh..gas.h: 现在比较便宜；碳价上涨后燃气费也会跟着涨。

zht..x: 你家的瓦斯鍋爐已經用了25年，暖氣師傅不敢保證它還能撐過一個冬天。裝熱泵可以拿到復興信貸銀行（KfW）的補助；新的瓦斯鍋爐現在比較便宜，但瓦斯的碳價一直在漲。
zht..hp.h: 之後二十年暖氣費比較低，也不用付碳價。
zht..gas.h: 現在比較便宜；碳價上漲後瓦斯費也會跟著漲。

events.src: From 2027 or 2028, CO2 prices for heating fuel are due to be set by the EU’s new ETS2 market and could rise well above today’s €55–65 a tonne (EU; BEHG). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('de_co2', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.de_co2') }); rec('de_co2', .03 * base, 15)
spend('de_hp', .85 * base, 'trk.de_hp'); T('de_hps', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_hps') }); rec('de_hps', -.03 * base, 15)

en..x: Your gas bill has jumped as the CO2 price on heating rises, and it is set to go on rising.
en..hp: Switch to a heat pump now
en..hp.s: About {a}, with a smaller grant than before.

zh..x: 暖气的碳价上涨，你的燃气账单跟着大涨，而且还会继续涨。

zht..x: 暖氣的碳價上漲，你的瓦斯帳單跟著大漲，而且還會繼續漲。

events.src: Aktivrente: since 1 January 2026, employees who keep working past the standard retirement age while drawing their state pension can earn up to €2,000 a month tax-free (§ 3 Nr. 21 EStG, via Bund der Steuerzahler); it doesn’t apply to the self-employed or to Minijobs. The hours and pay used here are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: T('de_akt', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_akt') }); rec('de_akt', -.55 * base, 3, -.2); happy += 1

en..x: Your old employer asks whether you would come back two days a week. Since 2026, up to €2,000 a month earned past retirement age is tax-free.
en..part: Go back two days a week
en..part.s: About {a} a year, tax-free, for a few years.
en..part.h: Happiness +1; Health a little lower each year.

zh..x: 以前的公司问你愿不愿意回去，一周上两天班。从2026年起，过了退休年龄还工作的话，每月最多2,000欧元的收入免税。
zh..part.h: 幸福感 +1；健康每年少一点。
zh.trk.de_akt: 领活力退休金继续工作

zht..x: 以前的公司問你願不願意回去，一週上兩天班。從2026年起，過了退休年齡還工作的話，每月最多2,000歐元的收入免稅。
zht..part.h: 幸福感 +1；健康每年少一點。
zht.trk.de_akt: 領活力退休金繼續工作

events.src: Civil-service teachers: most German states employ teachers as Beamte (civil servants), and Berlin went back to this in 2023-24 (Berlin Senate). Beamte cannot be laid off, pay no pension or unemployment contributions, receive a pension of up to 71.75% of final pay (Beamtenversorgungsgesetz) instead of the state pension, and take private health insurance with the state paying half or more of their bills (Beihilfe). A medical check by the public health officer comes first. Pay and pension effects are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: bump('de_beamt', 1.08, M('trk.de_beamt')); layM = (layM || 1) * .05; penM = (penM || 1) * 1.3; medPlan('de_beih', .4, .05 * base)

en..x: Your state now offers civil-service status to teachers. You would have a job for life and a civil-service pension, but first comes a medical check by the public health officer.
en..beamt.s: A job for life, private health insurance with state help, a civil-service pension.
en..beamt.h: Take-home pay about 8% higher, no layoffs, a much bigger pension.
en..ill: The health check would rule you out.
en..stay.s: Your contract and the state pension, as now.

zh..x: 你所在的州现在让教师成为公务员。那样就是铁饭碗，还有公务员退休金，但得先通过公卫医官的体检。
zh..beamt.s: 铁饭碗、有政府补助的私人医保，还有公务员退休金。
zh..beamt.h: 到手收入高约8%，不会被裁员，退休金高很多。
zh..stay.s: 维持现在的合约和国家养老金。
zh.trk.de_beih: 有公费补助的私人医保

zht..x: 你所在的邦現在讓教師成為公務員。那樣就是鐵飯碗，還有公務員退休金，但得先通過公衛醫官的體檢。
zht..beamt.s: 鐵飯碗、有政府補助的私人健康保險，還有公務員退休金。
zht..beamt.h: 到手收入高約8%，不會被裁員，退休金高很多。
zht..stay.s: 維持現在的合約和國家年金。
zht.trk.de_beih: 有公費補助的私人健康保險

events.src: Cross-border commuting: tens of thousands of people living in Germany work in Switzerland, mostly around Basel and Lake Constance (Swiss Federal Statistical Office, cross-border commuter statistics); they pay a 4.5% Swiss withholding tax and are taxed in Germany (Germany–Switzerland tax treaty). Pay (often far higher in Switzerland), the commute and the exchange-rate risk are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: tmpPay('de_ch', 1.5, 6, 'trk.de_ch'); T('de_chc', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_chc') }); rec('de_chc', .05 * base, 6, -.3); happy -= 1

en..t: A job across the Swiss border
en..x: A company in Basel offers you a job at Swiss pay. You would keep living in Germany and cross the border every morning, like thousands of your neighbours.
en..go.s: Swiss pay in francs and a longer commute.
en..go.h: Pay about 50% higher for six years; Health a little lower each year; Happiness −1, Relationships −2.

zh..x: 巴塞尔一家公司开出瑞士水平的薪水请你过去。你可以继续住在德国，每天早上过境上班，就像成千上万的邻居一样。
zh..go.s: 领瑞士法郎薪水，通勤更远。
zh..go.h: 六年内收入高约50%；健康每年少一点；幸福感 −1，人际关系 −2。

zht..x: 巴塞爾一家公司開出瑞士水準的薪水請你過去。你可以繼續住在德國，每天早上過境上班，就像成千上萬的鄰居一樣。
zht..go.s: 領瑞士法郎薪水，通勤更遠。
zht..go.h: 六年內收入高約50%；健康每年少一點；幸福感 −1，人際關係 −2。

events.src: Deutschlandticket: unlimited local and regional public transport across Germany for €63 a month from January 2026, up from €58 (transport ministers’ decision, via Finanztip). The full cost of keeping a small car (loss of value, insurance, tax, fuel, repairs) and its sale price are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Germany, about €22,000 a year (32,000 PPP dollars × 0.688).

opts.do: car = null; cash += .25 * base; T('de_dt', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.de_dt') }); rec('de_dt', -.08 * base, 10, .2); happy -= 1

en..x: Your car spends most of the week parked. With a Deutschlandticket at €63 a month you could take any bus, tram or regional train in the country.
en..sell: Sell it and get a Deutschlandticket
en..sell.s: Money from the sale now, and €63 a month.
en..sell.h: Saves about a twelfth of a typical wage a year; Health a little better each year from walking and cycling; Happiness −1.
en..keep.s: Door to door, whenever you like.

zh..x: 你的车一个星期大部分时间都停着。买一张每月63欧元的德国票，就能搭全国任何公交、电车和区域火车。
zh..sell.s: 现在拿到卖车的钱，之后每月63欧元。
zh..sell.h: 每年省下大约十二分之一个一般工资；多走路骑车让健康每年好一点；幸福感 −1。
zh..keep.s: 想去哪就去哪，门口到门口。

zht..x: 你的車一個星期大部分時間都停著。買一張每月63歐元的德國票，就能搭全國任何公車、電車和區域火車。
zht..sell.s: 現在拿到賣車的錢，之後每月63歐元。
zht..sell.h: 每年省下大約十二分之一個一般薪資；多走路騎車讓健康每年好一點；幸福感 −1。
zht..keep.s: 想去哪就去哪，門口到門口。
